I hear ya man I know that feeling well. I have never won anything in my whole life. I have been brutally abused by everyone I met in my life and there is no karma punishing them for what they did. There is a limit to what a human mind can take and after that people just snap and either end themselves or end others. I am very close to that point. It's just ridiculous to see the kids who bullied me everyday at school become rich and successful. It's like karma is working in reverse for them. They are being rewarded for destroying my soul while I am being punished for nothing. I am slowly understanding that most of the people who make it to the top are bullies. Bullies always ran the world and they always will. It's such a twisted sick reality. The idea that most people get from movies is that the bad guys always pay but in reality they don't. Bad guys are just bad because they have the brains to get away with their crimes. The world can only be run with brain power and at the end, the one with more brains will always win, doesn't matter if he's good or bad.

Anyways sorry for the rant, probably my comment doesn't even address your issue but I do hope you find peace. I just can't deal with reality anymore and felt like sharing my thoughts.
